description: Implement ActivityAware interface on VideoPlayerPlugin.java to gain Activity access. Add Activity supplier pattern via setActivitySupplier() for safe Activity lifecycle handling. Implement isPictureInPictureSupported() checking activity != null, API level >= 26 (Build.VERSION_CODES.O), and PackageManager.FEATURE_PICTURE_IN_PICTURE system feature. Guard all PiP methods against getActivity() == null.

Implement startPictureInPicture() in Java: build PictureInPictureParams with video aspect ratio from the primary PiP player's video dimensions, include auto-enter setting (Android 12+) and custom actions (if set), call activity.enterPictureInPictureMode(). Maintain a single accumulated PictureInPictureParams.Builder state to avoid param fragmentation. Implement stopPictureInPicture() by launching the Activity with FLAG_ACTIVITY_REORDER_TO_FRONT (no-op if not in PiP mode). Set primaryPipPlayerId when startPictureInPicture() is called.

Implement PiP mode change detection via Activity.registerComponentCallbacks() with a ComponentCallbacks2 implementation that checks activity.isInPictureInPictureMode() on configuration changes. When PiP mode changes, emit PictureInPictureStateEvent to ALL active players' event channels (since Android PiP is Activity-level). When a new player is registered while Activity is already in PiP mode, immediately emit PictureInPictureStateEvent(isInPictureInPicture: true) to the new player.

Implement setAutoPictureInPicture(bool) using setAutoEnterEnabled() on Android 12+ (API 31). On pre-Android 12, silent no-op. Implement custom PiP actions via RemoteAction with BroadcastReceiver for action handling. Maximum actions respect Activity.getMaxNumPictureInPictureActions(). BroadcastReceiver must be dynamically registered with unregisterReceiver() on plugin detach and player dispose. Use RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED flag on Android 14+ (API 34). PendingIntent must use FLAG_IMMUTABLE and be scoped to the app's package.

Implement Dart-side PiP delegation in AndroidVideoPlayer. Add isPictureInPictureSupported() calling _api.isPictureInPictureSupported(). Add stopPictureInPicture(int playerId), setAutoPictureInPicture(int playerId, bool enabled), setPictureInPictureActions(int playerId, List<PictureInPictureAction> actions) all delegating to player instance API. Handle PictureInPictureStateEvent in _PlayerInstance._onStreamEvent to emit VideoEvent with pictureInPictureStarted/Stopped. Map between platform interface PictureInPictureActionType and Pigeon PipActionType.
